title: SlimeBoysMC
description: Come say hi! Build something awesome, explore the world, or just hang out. We'd love to have you!
body:
Come say hi! Build something awesome, explore the world, or just hang out. We'd love to have you!

"We offer a laid-back, no-griefing experience perfect for players of all ages. Build freely, explore a massive world, and team up with others. Easy difficulty keeps things relaxing while still fun. No whitelist — just join and start your adventure today! We also have regular community events and a helpful Discord. See you in-game!"
